explanation: Rechecking gives x=(v−u)/5, y=(2u+3v)/5 and |∂(x,y)/∂(u,v)|=1/5. The four lines enclose the rectangle −2≤u≤2, 1≤v≤3, so the full parallelogram has area 8/5, option c. However, first-quadrant membership also requires u≤v and 2u+3v≥0. These remove triangles of uv-area 1/2 and 1/12, giving (8−1/2−1/12)/5=89/60. No displayed choice equals this. The earlier uncertainty therefore reflects a real contradiction in the first-quadrant premise.
